operator_io_quirks: Table names mixed case: Student, Club, Member_of_club; must double-quote in generated SQL.
Column names mixed case: StuID, LName, Fname, city_code, ClubID, ClubName, ClubDesc, ClubLocation, Position; case-insensitive lookup.
Member_of_club has NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must handle empty PK (no dedup) and drop_unique_duplicates has no unique cols.
Member_of_club has two FKs (StuID->Student.StuID, ClubID->Club.ClubID); both parents exist and are single-column INTEGER PKs.
No self-references, no composite keys, no dangling FKs, no non-unique parents in this DB.
All columns notnull=0 despite being logically required; sqlite will accept NULLs, TS may emit them.
All declared types dispatch cleanly: INTEGER->Number, VARCHAR(n)->String; no crash-fallback, no Date/Time/Bool/Bit columns.
VARCHAR(1) Sex and VARCHAR(3) city_code: String fuzzer length range [min len, max len+1] from elements, so short strings; contaminate can exceed declared length (sqlite ignores).
VARCHAR(1024) ClubDesc: String length range from 4 short samples, so TS will NOT produce long descriptions.
Tiny tables: Student 34 rows, Club 4, Member_of_club 4; choose_table_sizes will often exceed original sizes (up to 2500).
No views, triggers, or indexes beyond PKs; DDL clone is trivial.
All storage classes match declared types (integer/text); no affinity contradictions.
operator_ts_expectations: StuID/ClubID (single-col PK): Number fuzzer, max_l0=inf, p=0.2; fresh draws uniform in [-10^0,10^0]=[-1,1] then perturbed +-1/+-2 -> small ints, mostly NOT in original 1001..1034 / 1..4 range.

Age/Major/Advisor (INTEGER, non-PK): Number with max_l0 possibly capped (rng*30); fresh draws in [-1,1] perturbed -> implausible ages/majors/advisors (FN source: queries filtering Age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 or Major=600 will match few/no rows).

LName/Fname/Sex/city_code/ClubName/Position: String fuzzer, p=0.2 fresh random over a-zA-Z 0-9() with contaminate 50% -> garbage names, not 'Smith'/'F'/'BAL' (FN for equality filters, FP for LIKE '%a%').
Sex VARCHAR(1): String length range from ['F','M'] = [1,2]; fresh strings length 1-2, contaminate can add 5 chars -> 'Fxxxxx' etc.
Member_of_club.StuID/ClubID: FK fill draws from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement -> duplicates allowed (no PK), so join cardinalities can explode or collapse.
Member_of_club has no PK: sample_fresh_primary_keys no-op; drop_unique_duplicates no-op; rows kept as drawn.
Club only 4 rows originally; TS may generate up to 2500 -> join Student x Club x Member_of_club can be huge or empty depending on FK draw.
FK consistency: Member_of_club.StuID drawn from Student.StuID final values; if Student PK dedup drops rows, some FK values vanish -> orphan-free but sparse.
Number perturb on StuID (int) can produce 0 or negative -> FK to Student still consistent (drawn from parent), but standalone StuID filters like StuID=1001 miss.
String fuzzer adds str(i+1)/str(i-1) for int-like elements; city_code 'BAL' not int-like so no numeric neighbors.
Expected misses: FN from implausible Age/Major/Advisor and garbage names; FP from duplicate FK rows in Member_of_club (no PK) inflating COUNT(*) and join results.
